Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Warangal (NIT Warangal) for a research project under the Ministry of Textiles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow (JRF). There is a total of 1 vacancy available for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E/M.Tech degree in Structural Engineering or Engineering Structures with a First Class/Division and must have qualified the GATE examination.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application along with all required documents via email is 24-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for NIT Warangal JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted exclusively through email. Candidates need to send their bio-data, GATE scorecard, and certificates to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or monthly emolument for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive total emoluments amounting to Rs. 35960 per month as per institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for applying to the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at NIT Warangal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their application details and GATE scores, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the NIT Warangal JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be posted at the National Institute of Technology Warangal located in Warangal, Telangana, with the pincode 506004.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details and direct links in the respective sections of this article. Ensure you review all instructions before sending your application.
